item.title: Study suggests Trump’s unproven autism claims influenced care
item.description: Last year, President Donald Trump told pregnant women not to take Tylenol as he promoted unproven ties between the fever reducer and autism and touted an old generic drug as a treatment for the developmental condition. For nearly three months after that, new research found, Tylenol orders for pregnant women showing up in emergency rooms dropped and prescriptions of the generic drug for children rose.

item.title: Vancouver man sentenced to work crew after his abandoned dog was found dead
item.description: A Vancouver man was sentenced Wednesday to serve 30 days on a work crew after he left his German shepherd to starve to death in the Yacolt Burn area.

item.title: Justice Department publishes missing Epstein files involving uncorroborated claim about Trump
item.description: WASHINGTON — The Justice Department on Thursday released additional Jeffrey Epstein files involving uncorroborated accusations made by a woman against President Donald Trump that the department said had been mistakenly withheld during an earlier review.

item.title: Ferguson outlines his requirements for WA ‘millionaires tax’
item.description: OLYMPIA — A day after the Senate passed a revised income tax bill, Gov. Bob Ferguson on Tuesday called it a “good start” and for the first time detailed his conditions for signing it, including $1 billion in small business-tax relief and a major expansion of the state’s Working Families Tax Credit.
